recognitionRules: Use Anton headlines against Courier Prime commentary.
Keep cream paper, near-black ink and selective lime as the recurring relationship.
Number stories and alternate their composition without changing the editorial hierarchy.
Use collage as a subject-bearing image, not texture behind long copy.

writingLinks.name: Reflective critic
writingLinks.reason: An expressive editorial journal where criticism and essays are the main content.

quote: Look at what gathers at the edges. There is a story there.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use MARGIN CULTURE in a condensed Anton stack with a small Courier Prime issue number. A displaced rule may suggest the margin; no circular stamp.
invariants: Use Anton headlines against Courier Prime commentary.
Keep cream paper, near-black ink and selective lime as the recurring relationship.
Number stories and alternate their composition without changing the editorial hierarchy.
adaptations: Each issue may change collage material and lead color accent.
Article pages simplify to headline, image, caption and reading text.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
